name: linecounter
description: Browse your workspace as a filterable tree, exclude files and folders with a click and generate full-screen code statistics with charts, git insights, fun facts and a file ranking.

commands.title: Copy MCP Server Configuration (for LLM agents)

enumDescriptions: Open the statistics page maximized (side bars and panel hidden).
Maximized and additionally switch the VS Code window to full screen.
Open the statistics page like a normal editor tab.
linecounter.statisticsLayout.description: How the statistics page is opened.

linecounter.maxFileSizeKB.description: Files larger than this (in KB) are counted by size only; their lines are not analyzed.

linecounter.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of files and folders scanned for the tree.

linecounter.maxCommits.description: Maximum number of commits read per git repository.

linecounter.rant.enabled.description: Show the "Code Rant" section that complains about files that are too long or contain too many blank lines.

linecounter.rant.maxFileLines.description: Rant about files longer than this many lines.

linecounter.rant.maxBlankPercent.description: Rant about files (with at least 10 lines) and the whole project when more than this percentage of lines is blank.

linecounter.rant.commitMinLength.description: Rant about commit messages (subject line) shorter than this many characters.

linecounter.rant.commitMaxLength.description: Rant about commit messages (subject line) longer than this many characters.

linecounter.rant.commitWords.markdownDescription: Words or phrases in commit messages to rant about. Leave empty for the built-in list (`wip`, `asdf`, `tmp`, `stuff`, `misc`, `oops`, `typo`, `final`, `please`, `hack`, `whatever`, `idk`, `wtf`, `lol`, `yolo`, `again`, `why`, `test`, `changes`, `update`, `minor`, …).

linecounter.excludePatterns.markdownDescription: Additional glob patterns to exclude, like `.gitignore` (e.g. `*.generated.ts`, `docs/`, `/build`, `src/**/*.spec.ts`). Shown as the predefined filter *Custom patterns*.

linecounter.defaultFilters.description: Predefined filters that are enabled in a new workspace (unless a preset from .linecounter/presets.json is active).

enumDescriptions: Word web wiggles, import and structure graphs are calm
Graphs settle and then stop moving
No animation: the layout is computed once and drawn static

linecounter.dependencies.enabled.description: Scan package.json / requirements.txt / pyproject.toml / Pipfile / setup.py for the dependency, license and vulnerability report.

linecounter.licenses.problematic.markdownDescription: Licenses that are flagged as **problematic** (SPDX ids, `*` wildcards). Example: `GPL*` matches GPL-2.0 and GPL-3.0, but not LGPL.

linecounter.licenses.review.markdownDescription: Licenses that **need a review** (weak copyleft, unknown or custom licenses).

linecounter.licenses.allowed.markdownDescription: Optional allowlist. If set, every license that does not match is flagged as problematic (e.g. `["MIT", "BSD*", "Apache-2.0", "ISC"]`).

linecounter.licenses.ignorePackages.description: Packages that are accepted exceptions: they stay in the report but are not flagged or checked for vulnerabilities.

linecounter.licenses.includeTransitive.description: Include installed transitive packages (from package-lock.json / node_modules / the virtual environment) in the license report.

linecounter.vulnerabilities.enabled.markdownDescription: Check npm and PyPI packages for known vulnerabilities via [OSV.dev](https://osv.dev). Only package names and versions are sent.

linecounter.vulnerabilities.includeTrans.description: Also check transitive (installed but not declared) packages for vulnerabilities.

linecounter.licenses.fetchFromRegistry.markdownDescription: Look up the license of packages that are declared but not installed in the public registries (registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org). Only package names are sent.

linecounter.train.keys.description: Key bindings of the 3D train: forward (drive / thrust), back (turn around / brake), left/right (choose relation / steer), up/down (climb / dive when flying), snap (snap back onto the nearest relation), fly (leave the rails), camera.

linecounter.graphs.maxFunctions.description: Maximum number of functions shown when functions are switched on in the import graph and the 3D train.

linecounter.health.enabled.description: Code health scan: complexity per function, long functions, duplicate code.

linecounter.health.maxComplexity.description: Functions with a higher cyclomatic complexity are flagged (and roasted).

linecounter.health.maxFunctionLines.description: Functions longer than this are flagged.

linecounter.health.duplicateMinLines.description: Minimum number of identical (normalized) lines that count as duplicated code.

linecounter.secrets.enabled.description: Scan for hard-coded secrets (API keys, tokens, private keys, passwords). Values are masked in the report.

linecounter.secrets.ignore.description: Glob patterns of files that are not scanned for secrets.

linecounter.history.enabled.description: Remember the key numbers of every run (per workspace) and show trends on the statistics page.

linecounter.history.saveToFile.description: Also store the history in .linecounter/history.json so that it can be committed and shared with the team.

linecounter.graphs.maxNodes.description: Maximum number of nodes in the 2D graphs (import graph, structure graph). The most connected files are kept, cycles and chains always.

linecounter.graphs.maxLinks.description: Maximum number of relations (edges) drawn in the import graph. Circular imports are always kept.

linecounter.train.maxNodes.description: Maximum number of planets in the 3D train view (the 3D layout gets slow with thousands of nodes). The most connected files are kept.

linecounter.customFilters.description: Own filters shown as checkboxes in the sidebar (in addition to .linecounter/filters.json), e.g. [{"label": "Data folders", "patterns": ["*/data"]}].

linecounter.architecture.rules.description: Architecture rules: files matching "from" must not import files matching "disallow" (globs, relative to the project root), e.g. [{"from": "src/ui/**", "disallow": ["src/db/**"]}].

linecounter.architecture.layers.description: Ordered layers from top to bottom; a layer may import lower layers but never higher ones, e.g. [{"name":"ui","pattern":"src/ui/**"},{"name":"services","pattern":"src/services/**"},{"name":"db","pattern":"src/db/**"}].

linecounter.gate.description: Quality gate (command "Line Counter: Run Quality Gate" and CLI "node bin/linecounter.js gate"): which findings make it fail.

linecounter.ownership.staleDays.description: Files without a commit for this many days count as stale (Ownership section).

linecounter.todos.enabled.description: TODO tracker: list every TODO / FIXME / HACK / XXX / BUG comment with author and age (git blame).

linecounter.compare.enabled.description: Branch comparison: compare the current branch with its base (when you are not on the base branch).

linecounter.compare.baseBranch.description: Base branch for the comparison (empty = origin/HEAD, main, master or develop).

scripts.test: node test/smoke.js && node test/graphs.test.js && node test/deps.test.js && node test/rustgo.test.js && node test/todos.test.js
